subtext: How a repository becomes a durable model of an application.
abstract: Change Saga is a local Go application that keeps product knowledge and review explanations beside source code. The durable state is a directory of small, versioned records and authored assets committed to Git. A compiled CLI writes those records, projects bounded JSON for coding tools, and starts a loopback HTTP server for the browser reader. The same repository can therefore be inspected from a terminal, reviewed visually, and merged through ordinary Git workflows.
title: Technical design
